title: Product-intelligence evidence ledger
description: Flat, auditable record of every material claim in a product brief. Each claim is one atomic proposition carrying its source, evidence class, and confidence. Contradictions are recorded, never reconciled.

ledger_version.description: Semver of the ledger schema this document targets. Backward-compatible across minors.

generated_by.description: Tool/skill identifier that produced this ledger.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 date (or date-time) the ledger was produced.

id.description: Stable, referenceable handle. A claim may be restated in prose anywhere without duplicating the entry.

statement.description: Exactly one atomic proposition. A statement needing 'and' is two claims.

class.description: What kind of statement this is. Independent of confidence and never merged with it.

confidence.description: How solid the basis is. Independent of class.

sources.description: Where the claim comes from. Required for observed/inferred; empty is only valid for proposed/unverified.

derived_from.description: Claim ids this claim is inferred from. Populated only when class is 'inferred'.

contradicts.description: Claim ids this claim stands in unresolved contradiction with. A populated value is a valid terminal state — rendered in the brief, never silently resolved.

quote.description: Verbatim excerpt from the source. The quote is what makes a fabricated citation catchable without opening the source.

stance.description: How this source relates to the claim.

as_of.description: ISO-8601 date the source was retrieved or published.
